### Load annotation file

- Get significantly differentially expressed proteins 

```{r}

differential_protein_enrichment_df <- readRDS(file.path(save_dir, "02-rots-differential-enrichment-analysis-results.rds"))
significant_differentially_enriched_proteins_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(differential_protein_enrichment_df, function(temp_df){
    temp_df[temp_df$fdr_prop >= 0.3,]
}))
rownames(significant_differentially_enriched_proteins_df) <- NULL

keep_proteins_df <- significant_differentially_enriched_proteins_df[significant_differentially_enriched_proteins_df$comparison %in% c("VCP_CTRL_vs_CTRL_CTRL", "VCP_ERAP2_vs_CTRL_ERAP2"),]
keep_proteins_df$direction <- ifelse(keep_proteins_df$logfc < 0, "down", "up")


```
- Get uniprot ids from biomart

```{r include = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

ensembl <- useMart("ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")
search_names <- unique(keep_proteins_df$protein_name)

protein_ids_df <- biomaRt::getBM(attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "description", "hgnc_symbol", "gene_biotype"),#,"entrezgene" 
                                filters = "hgnc_symbol", 
                                values = search_names, 
                                mart = ensembl)

get_fields <- c("uniprotswissprot", "interpro", "ncbifam", "pfscan", "pfam", "smart", "cdd", 
    "gene3d", "superfamily", "hamap", "chembl")

all_protein_data_list <- lapply(get_fields, function(x){
    message(x)
    return_df <- biomaRt::getBM(
        attributes = c("hgnc_symbol", x),#,"entrezgene" 
        filters = "hgnc_symbol", 
        values = search_names, 
        mart = ensembl)
})

protein_data_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(search_names, function(x){
    return_df <- protein_ids_df[protein_ids_df$hgnc_symbol == x,]
    a_list <- list()
    field_list <- lapply(seq_along(get_fields), function(y){
        current_df <- all_protein_data_list[[y]]
        return(current_df[current_df$hgnc_symbol == x & current_df[,2] != "",2])
    })
    rep_fields <- rep(get_fields, times = vapply(field_list, length,1))
    return_df$db <- CharacterList(rep_fields)
    return_df$db_value <- CharacterList(do.call(c, field_list))
    return(return_df)
}))



```

- Make rest calls to interpro and fetch information

```{r}

require("httr")
require("jsonlite")

unique_interpro_ids <- unique(protein_ids_df$interpro)

main_url <- "https://www.ebi.ac.uk/interpro"
endpoints <- c(
    "entry" = "api/entry",
    "protein" = "api/protein",
    "structure" = "api/structure",
    "set" = "api/set",
    "taxonomy" = "api/taxonomy",
    "proteome" = "api/proteome")

db_reference <- c("uniprotswissprot" = "uniprot", 
    "interpro" = "interpro", 
    "ncbifam" = "ncbifam", 
    "pfscan" = "profile", 
    "pfam" = "pfam", 
    "smart" = "smart", 
    "cdd" = "cdd", 
    "gene3d" = "cathgene3d", 
    "superfamily" = "ssf", 
    "hamap" = "hamap", 
    "chembl" = "chembl")

entry_list <- list()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(protein_data_df))) {
    temp_df <- protein_data_df[i,]
    message(temp_df$hgnc_symbol)
    dbs <- temp_df$db[[1]]
    db_values <- temp_df$db_value[[1]]

    db_values <- db_values[dbs != "chembl"]
    dbs <- dbs[dbs != "chembl"]
    if(any(db_values %in% names(entry_list))){
        a_filter <- !(db_values %in% names(entry_list))
        db_values <- db_values[a_filter]
        dbs <- dbs[a_filter]
    }

    return_list <- lapply(db_values, function(x){
        message(x)
        current_db <- dbs[db_values == x]
        if(current_db == "uniprotswissprot"){
            current_path <- file.path(main_url, endpoints["protein"], db_reference[current_db], x)
        }else{
            if(current_db == "gene3d"){
                current_id <- paste("G3DSA", x, sep = ":")
            }else{
                current_id <- x
            }
            current_path <- file.path(main_url, endpoints["entry"], db_reference[current_db], current_id)    
        }
        status_code = 404
        while(status_code != 200){
            get_details <- GET(current_path)
            status_code <- status_code(get_details)
            get_text <- content(get_details, "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
            get_list <- fromJSON(get_text, flatten = TRUE)
        }
        return(list(db = current_db, metadata = do.call(c, get_list)))
    })
    names(return_list) <- db_values
    entry_list <- c(entry_list, return_list)
}

require("parallel")
formatted_entry_list <- mclapply(names(entry_list), function(x){
    message(x)
    gene_list <- do.call(c, lapply(seq_len(nrow(protein_data_df)), function(y){
        temp_df <- protein_data_df[y,]
        db_values <- temp_df$db_value[[1]]
        if(x %in% db_values){
            return(temp_df$hgnc_symbol)
        }else{
            return(NULL)
        }
    }))
    return(list(members = gene_list, db = entry_list[[x]]$db, metadata = entry_list[[x]]$metadata))
}, mc.cores = 6)
names(formatted_entry_list) <- names(entry_list)


saveRDS(object = formatted_entry_list, file = file.path(save_dir, "05-all-interpro-metadata-entry-list.rds"))


```

- Find proteins which have a lot of domains

```{r}

length_of_domains <- vapply(formatted_entry_list, function(x){
    length(x$members)
},1)

domain_frequency_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(formatted_entry_list, function(x){
    message(x$db)
    name <- x$metadata$metadata.name
    if(class(name) == "list"){
        name <- name$name
    }
    if(is.null(name)){
        name <- "Undefined"
    }
    data.frame(db = x$db, name = name, n_members = length(x$members))
}))

```

- Plot domain frequency for interpro signatures


```{r}


lapply(unique(domain_frequency_df$db), function(a_db){
    boo <- domain_frequency_df[domain_frequency_df$db == a_db & domain_frequency_df$n_members > 1,]
    head(boo[order(boo$n_members, decreasing = T),], 10)
})
interpro_df <- domain_frequency_df[domain_frequency_df$db == "interpro",]
plot_df <- interpro_df[order(interpro_df$n_members, decreasing = T),][1:20,]

plot_df$name <- factor(plot_df$name, levels = plot_df$name[order(plot_df$n_members, decreasing = F)])

ThePlot <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = n_members, y = name))
ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_point(fill = "#FF4242", colour = "#000000")
# ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_boxplot(fill = "#E2E2E2", colour = "#000000", 
#     width = 0.1, lwd = 0.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), outlier.shape = NA)
ThePlot <- ThePlot + scale_x_continuous("number of proteins containing signature")
ThePlot <- ThePlot + scale_y_discrete("domain signature")
ThePlot <- ThePlot + theme_bw()
ThePlot <- ThePlot + ggtitle("Interpro domain signature frequency")
# ThePlot <- ThePlot + facet_grid(metadata ~ ., scales = "free")
ThePlot <- ThePlot + theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "azure3",
    linetype = "dashed",
    size = 0.2))
ggsave(width = 10, height = 10, file = file.path(plot_dir, "08-01-plot-number-of-proteins-containing-domain-signature.pdf"), ThePlot)
```
